messages:
Maria Chen: FYI — postmortem follow-ups for last week's external-dependency outage (cloud CDN + model-registry auth failures). Need clear owners and timelines so we don't keep repeating the same escalation pattern.
Ajay Patel: Agreed. I started a tracker board: https://outboards.internal/rw-dep-mitigations (permissions open to eng/ops/product). I'll create cards per action item.
Kenji Sato: I can own the auth-provider fallback test plan. Proposed scope: daily synthetic auth failures, verify cached tokens fallback, and end-to-end inference with model-registry read-only fallback. Due EOD Fri (2026-04-03).
Samir Gupta: Can you add a checklist template in the card for required telemetry + SLIs to validate? Things to capture: auth latency, 5xx rate, cache-hit ratio, KV cache evictions.
Kenji Sato: Will add checklist + sample query logs. Also adding a small script for simulated token rejection:```
# simulate auth provider 401s
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer BAD_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
Elaine Park: I'll take vendor SLA review and vendor contact playbook. Deliverable: updated vendor escalation matrix + contact aliases in PagerDuty by next Tue (2026-04-06).
Maria Chen: Action items so far: 1) Auth test plan — Kenji — 2026-04-03; 2) Vendor SLA/contact updates — Elaine — 2026-04-06; 3) Runbook update for model-registry fallback — Ajay/Kenji — 2026-04-05; 4) Incident retro summary + recurring pattern notes — Samir — 2026-04-04. Please confirm or reassign.
Ajay Patel: I'll pair with Kenji on the runbook update and raise a PR against infra/runbooks: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pulls. PR target: 2026-04-05.
Samir Gupta: I'll take the retro summary. Need a quick ask: everyone paste one repeat pattern bullet into the tracker card by EOD tomorrow so I can synthesize.
Kenji Sato: @Samir noted. Adding: repeated pattern = auth provider token rotation window + sudden 401 spike that cascades into model-registry retries.
Maria Chen: Also flagging a platform mitigation: we should enable model-registry read-only replica routing for auth failures — low-risk toggle. Ops team: how long to expose toggle?
ops-bot: :robot_face: Runbook task created: "toggle-readonly-replica" assigned to eng-infra. ETA CI: 2 business days. Ticket: #INF-4821.
Ajay Patel: We'll need a smoke test after the toggle; propose a 15-min dry-run during low-traffic window. I'll schedule and invite infra/oncall.
Elaine Park: I'll coordinate legal/comms for any vendor notices if we hit SLA thresholds again. Also want a quarterly vendor health review added to the vendor-board.
Samir Gupta: Quick question — do we want automated failover to a secondary cloud region for registry reads, or is read-only replica + cache good enough? Pros/cons in the tracker please.
Kenji Sato: I'll write a short section in the runbook comparing options (local fallback cache vs cross-region replica vs queued reads).
Maria Chen: Please update the tracker card names to include "owner — due" so it's easy in weekly ops sync.
Ajay Patel: Done. Card names updated.
Kenji Sato: Volunteers for running the first auth-failure dry-run? I'll lead but need someone to monitor prod telemetry and escalate.
Samir Gupta: I'll monitor and take telemetry escalation during the dry-run.
Maria Chen: Great. Final ask: anyone assigning long-term remediation (like redesigning auth flow) mark it as "project" not incident action; we want incident actions to be lean and timeboxed.
incident-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Vendor-dep mitigations follow-up" — 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to participants.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — I'll follow up in the tracker and mark ownerships. Please add your short pattern notes into the card by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
